content:
name: VENDR CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Build, Lint & Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node.js 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 12.21.0

      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.local/share/pnpm/store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build Packages & Apps
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Run Core API & WASM Integration Tests
        run: pnpm --filter @vendr/api test

  docker-build:
    name: Docker Containerization Healthcheck
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker API Container
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: apps/api/Dockerfile
          push: false
          tags: vendr-api:test

      - name: Build Docker Admin Container
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: apps/admin/Dockerfile
          push: false
          tags: vendr-admin:test

      - name: Build Docker Storefront Container
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: apps/storefront/Dockerfile
          push: false
          tags: vendr-storefront:test

name: Open Shopify OmniShop Universal OS Release Matrix

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-android:
    name: Build Android (APK & AAB)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Flutter 3.24
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.24.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter Dependencies
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Run Tests
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build Release APK
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build apk --release

      - name: Build Release App Bundle (AAB)
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build appbundle --release

      - name: Upload Android Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: omnishop-android
          path: |
            apps/omnishop/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
            apps/omnishop/build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab

  build-linux:
    name: Build Linux Desktop (AppImage & DEB)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Linux Build Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y clang cmake ninja-build pkg-config libgtk-3-dev liblzma-dev

      - name: Set up Flutter 3.24
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.24.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter Dependencies
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Build Linux Binary
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build linux --release

      - name: Package Linux Binary Archive
        working-directory: apps/omnishop/build/linux/x64/release/bundle
        run: tar -czvf omnishop-linux-x64.tar.gz *

      - name: Upload Linux Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: omnishop-linux
          path: apps/omnishop/build/linux/x64/release/bundle/omnishop-linux-x64.tar.gz

  build-windows:
    name: Build Windows Desktop (.exe / MSIX)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Flutter 3.24
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.24.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter Dependencies
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Build Windows Executable
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build windows --release

      - name: Compress Windows Release Bundle
        run: |
          Compress-Archive -Path apps\omnishop\build\windows\x64\runner\Release\* -DestinationPath omnishop-windows-x64.zip

      - name: Upload Windows Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: omnishop-windows
          path: omnishop-windows-x64.zip

  build-apple:
    name: Build Apple Ecosystem (macOS DMG & iOS IPA)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Flutter 3.24
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.24.x'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter Dependencies
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Build macOS Desktop Application
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build macos --release

      - name: Build iOS Archive (No Codesign)
        working-directory: apps/omnishop
        run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign

      - name: Compress macOS Application
        working-directory: apps/omnishop/build/macos/Build/Products/Release
        run: zip -r omnishop-macos.zip omnishop.app

      - name: Upload Apple Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: omnishop-apple
          path: apps/omnishop/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/omnishop-macos.zip

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vendr-admin
  namespace: vendr
  labels:
    app: vendr-admin
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vendr-admin
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vendr-admin
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: admin
          image: ghcr.io/abdulaaly/vendr-admin:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3001
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: vendr-config
          env:
            - name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
              value: "http://vendr-api:4000"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "800m"
              memory: "1024Mi"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vendr-admin
  namespace: vendr
spec:
  selector:
    app: vendr-admin
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3001
      targetPort: 3001

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vendr-api
  namespace: vendr
  labels:
    app: vendr-api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vendr-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vendr-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/abdulaaly/vendr-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 4000
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: vendr-config
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: "postgresql://vendr:vendr_secure_password_2026@vendr-postgres:5432/vendr_commerce?schema=public"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1000m"
              memory: "1536Mi"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: 4000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: 4000
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vendr-api
  namespace: vendr
spec:
  selector:
    app: vendr-api
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 4000
      targetPort: 4000

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: vendr-config
  namespace: vendr
data:
  NODE_ENV: "production"
  PORT_API: "4000"
  PORT_ADMIN: "3001"
  PORT_STOREFRONT: "3000"
  REDIS_URL: "redis://vendr-redis:6379"

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: vendr-api-hpa
  namespace: vendr
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: vendr-api
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 20
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 75
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: vendr-storefront-hpa
  namespace: vendr
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: vendr-storefront
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: vendr-ingress
  namespace: vendr
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
spec:
  rules:
    - host: admin.vendr.local
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: vendr-admin
                port:
                  number: 3001
    - host: api.vendr.local
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: vendr-api
                port:
                  number: 4000
    - host: vendr.local
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: vendr-storefront
                port:
                  number: 3000

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: vendr
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vendr
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: vendr-commerce

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vendr-storefront
  namespace: vendr
  labels:
    app: vendr-storefront
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vendr-storefront
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vendr-storefront
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: storefront
          image: ghcr.io/abdulaaly/vendr-storefront:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: vendr-config
          env:
            - name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
              value: "http://vendr-api:4000"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "800m"
              memory: "1024Mi"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vendr-storefront
  namespace: vendr
spec:
  selector:
    app: vendr-storefront
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3000
      targetPort: 3000
